description: Version 3 SHA-256 bindings. Recipe fingerprints include recipe id, servings, ordered ingredient identities, amounts, units, calculation-relevant ingredient states, and ordered cooking_method steps; free preparation prose and editorial copy are ignored. Calculation-input fingerprints include mappings, portions, conversions, numeric assumptions, and evidence-presence flags. Calculation-evidence fingerprints track source identity, food state and basis, normalized carbohydrate, and only the numeric carbohydrate components used by the source definition (CHO, plus polyols for EU totals including polyols or fibre for US totals including fibre), as well as GI values, match keys, and quality fields. Source titles, retrieval metadata, prose, and citation URL formatting do not change calculations. A real source or recipe mismatch blocks publication until reviewed.
